ChunkLoadingWebpackPlugin.summary.en:
The ChunkLoadingWebpackPlugin enables chunk loading for Rspack in Lynx.
It only takes effect when `output.chunkLoading` is `'lynx'`.
ChunkLoadingWebpackPlugin.summary.text: ChunkLoadingWebpackPlugin 为 Lynx 中的 Rspack 启用 chunk 加载能力。仅在 `output.chunkLoading` 为 `'lynx'` 时生效。

ChunkLoadingWebpackPlugin.defaultOptions.en: `defaultOptions` is the default options that the [`ChunkLoadingWebpackPlugin`](api:ChunkLoadingWebpackPlugin) uses.
ChunkLoadingWebpackPlugin.defaultOptions.text: `defaultOptions` 是 [`ChunkLoadingWebpackPlugin`](api:ChunkLoadingWebpackPlugin) 使用的默认选项。

ChunkLoadingWebpackPlugin.apply.summary.en: The entry point of a webpack plugin.
